subject: Student Advisory Council Policy Recommendations
overview: The subcommittee met with student representatives to recap the year's progress and discuss future initiatives regarding district policy and student involvement. The body explored codifying student advisory roles, revamping homework and bathroom policies, and improving transportation infrastructure.

items.title: Budget and Student Advisory Recap
items.summary: Members and students reviewed the Student Advisory Council's advocacy for the requested school budget and reflected on the year's accomplishments.

items.title: Student Council Organizational Framework
items.summary: Student leaders presented definition documents to standardize advisory roles and announced an upcoming conference for Greater Boston League student councils.

items.title: Homework and Testing Policy Review
items.summary: The subcommittee discussed revamping the district-wide homework policy to better manage student workloads and address social-emotional concerns regarding stress.

items.title: Transportation Safety and Bike Infrastructure
items.summary: Administration updated the body on grant applications for bike repair stations and the installation of safety barriers on Steve Miller Drive.

items.title: High School Scheduling and Career Pathways
items.summary: Discussions focused on resolving scheduling conflicts between vocational and academic courses and exploring innovative career-focused education pathways.

items.title: Bathroom Policy Proposals
items.summary: Student representatives identified bathroom safety and accessibility as a priority for the upcoming school year, citing challenges with student conduct.

items.title: Student Representation at Public Meetings
items.summary: The committee considered strategies for diversifying student representation at meetings to ensure student voices are heard from all grade levels.
